nodes.name: CMakeLists.txt
nodes.summary: CMake build configuration for the opcua_usb_stdio example, defining the target executable from six C source files, linking against WIZnet Ethernet/IO libraries and the open62541 OPC UA port, and enabling USB CDC stdio while disabling UART.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses pico_enable_stdio_usb to route all printf output over USB CDC, a common pattern for Pico-based examples that avoids needing a UART adapter.

nodes.name: README_eng.md
nodes.summary: English user guide for the OPC UA USB stdio example, covering firmware upload, Tera Term serial setup, UaExpert server discovery and connection, real-time node browsing via Data Access View, and the full set of USB serial commands.

nodes.name: README_kor.md
nodes.summary: Korean-language user guide for the OPC UA USB stdio example, providing the same step-by-step instructions as the English README for firmware upload, Tera Term configuration, UaExpert connection, and USB serial data commands.
nodes.languageNotes: Bilingual documentation pattern (README_eng.md + README_kor.md) is used consistently across WIZnet example directories to serve both English and Korean audiences.
